title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: MSR > C > D > CD patched with AUD

ai_review.summary: Audience‑only recording with occasional mix quirks captures a high‑energy 1973 show highlighted by a stellar Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as a “slammin’” and “wicked” 1973 outing, with Dark Star standing out as the night’s centerpiece. The recording is an audience tape that suffers from some odd audio artifacts and a weak mix on Wharf Rat, but it still delivers the classic Dead vibe for listeners who enjoy ’73 shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high (energetic, standout Dark Star) while recording quality is fair due to audience source and mix issues; weighted average yields ~3.7 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience‑only tape with occasional funny audio artifacts; Bill Kreutzmann's drum mix is noted as poor, especially on Wharf Rat; stage mics were not used.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 1973 set structure with strong momentum throughout, though exact sequencing is unknown.
